column1: # expected-skips.tsv — the tests that may skip in the container leg, by name.
# A skipped test is reported as a pass, so a run that lost a tool reads as
# green. scripts/run-tests-container.sh hands this file to run-tests.sh
# (MANIFEST_CLI_TEST_EXPECTED_SKIPS), which fails the run when a test skips
# that is not listed here, or skips for a reason other than the one listed.
# One row per test, three tab-separated fields:
#   1. the test's name, exactly as its @test line has it
#   2. its skip reason, exactly as its skip line has it
#   3. why it cannot run in this leg, and where it runs instead
# To add a row: say in field 3 where the coverage went. A row is an allowance
# for that one test and that one reason; it gives no room to any other.
# tests/container_expected_skips.bats fails on a row whose test or reason no
# longer exists, so a renamed or deleted test cannot leave an allowance behind.
# A listed test that runs after all is reported by the runner, not failed.
